name: opencode 2.x
description: Installs the opencode 2.x CLI (opencode.ai) system-wide and the opencode VS Code extension. Requires curl, tar and bash in the base image. Pairs with shared-agent-config, which shares its login and keeps its sessions per project.

version.description: opencode version to install, e.g. 2.3.2. 'latest' installs the newest 2.x release.
